question: Does the exact Xe2 CUTLASS BLOCK_FP8 M16-small/M32-direct candidate remain numerically invariant and meet the catalog latency gates when both candidate and oneDNN consume the noncontiguous KxN transposed view over physical row-major NxK weight storage used by production vLLM?

correction_from_r127_through_r132.finding: Those screens constructed weight_nk.t().contiguous(), a physical KxN layout. Production XPUW8A16ScaledMMLinearKernel retains weight.data.t(), a noncontiguous KxN view with strides [1,K] over physical row-major NxK storage.
correction_from_r127_through_r132.scope: Their arithmetic-invariance proofs remain valid, but their latency and catalog-selection conclusions are diagnostic and not production-authoritative. R133 is the first CUTLASS all-shape screen with the production NT layout on both candidate and oneDNN control.

candidate.selection: Use CUTLASS BLOCK_FP8 policy [16,64,32] for M<=8 and [32,64,32] for M>8, with scale group [128,128], direct tile grid, one expert, and no scheduler scratch allocation.
candidate.weight_contract: The Python argument is a noncontiguous [K,N] view with stride [1,K]; the C++ wrapper unsqueezes it to [1,K,N] and interprets the physical storage as row-major [N,K].

artifacts.build_note: The exact patch chain reproduced the built interface byte-for-byte. A no-device ABI preflight in the exact R62 image imported the mounted extension and registered torch.ops._xpu_C.cutlass_grouped_gemm_interface. The build emitted no spill diagnostic for the M16/M32 policies.

gates.layout: The candidate input and oneDNN control must both use the production noncontiguous [K,N] view with stride [1,K].
gates.identity_and_numerical: Every shape must have one row-0 digest class across M, exact M512 prefixes, exact M200 permutation/repeat, exact M168 random appended-row content, finite output, and max absolute error versus oneDNN <=0.06.
gates.latency_for_selection: A shape may select CUTLASS only if geometric-mean candidate/oneDNN <=1.15 and no timed M exceeds 1.50x. Duplicated K3072/N5120 shapes must select the same mechanism.
gates.catalog_progress: All four unique K/N families must have a passing exact mechanism before an integrated binary. Shapes that fail remain on a separately proven pinned oneDNN policy; no server is authorized by this screen alone.
gates.health: No new Xe fault, reset, timeout, hang, coredump, or device loss.
gates.on_pass: Implement the narrow heterogeneous production binary, rerun all-six operator gates, then enforce a call-count-weighted <=3% decode-step overhead gate before server execution.
gates.on_failure: Preserve the result and close failing CUTLASS shape families unless one bounded tile hypothesis remains. Do not launch a server.
